question: Where is the nearest café when heading toward Missouri State University, Fairfax, VA from Battle of the Bulge Memorial, VA?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Battle of the Bulge Memorial%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%VA%' LIMIT 1 ), destination_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Missouri State University%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Fairfax%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%VA%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, start_point s, destination_point d WHERE p.amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, s.geometry::geography, 50000) -- Search within 50km of the start point AND ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, d.geometry::geography) < ST_Distance(s.geometry::geography, d.geometry::geography) -- Cafe is closer to the destination than the start point AND ABS( (degrees(ST_Azimuth(s.geometry, p.geometry)) - degrees(ST_Azimuth(s.geometry, d.geometry)) + 540)::numeric % 360 - 180 ) <= 45 -- Cafe is within +/- 45 degrees of the direction from start to destination ORDER BY ST_Distance(s.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
